description: This file defines the UserRoleManagerHelper class, which provides helper methods to interact with user role management and permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It wraps access to the UserRoleManager service and offers methods for obtaining data group permissions, permission collections, and checking employee access rights.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing simplified access to user role management functionalities such as retrieving permissions and permission collections, and checking employee access rights within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of AbstractUserRoleManager or BasicUserRoleManager from the service container.

methods.name: getEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Returns data group permissions without considering specific employee or entity context.

methods.name: geEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of data group permissions without considering specific employee or entity context.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves data group permissions for a specific employee, with optional employee number parameter.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Returns a collection of data group permissions for a specified employee.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the provided employee number matches the logged-in user's employee number.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Checks if an employee is accessible either via entity permissions or if the employee corresponds to the logged-in user.
